**Constitution Alignment Issues:** None. Standard-library, local deterministic behavior, explicit decisions, no automatic integration and unit-test validation are reflected in the plan and tasks.

**Unmapped Tasks:** None. T001 is contract/design history; T002/T003 establish the shared foundation; T012 documents the tested runtime and limitations. These support the specified contract without additional product scope.

**Metrics:** 12 requirement/criterion keys (9 FR and 3 buildable validation SC), 12 tasks, 100% coverage, 0 ambiguities, 0 duplications, 0 critical issues. All 12 task markers are checked; zero unfinished tasks.

**Current correction checks:** FR-008 specifies exit status 2, matching its accepted clarification, input-rejection entity, US2 independent test, plan, CLI contract and T008/T010. The introductory task statement now explicitly describes unchecked status at generation and current completed status; I-802-TASK-INTRO is resolved. The plan, research and quickstart use design-stage context and future validation instructions; actual execution evidence is separately and explicitly recorded in validation/implementation.md. Those historical instructions introduce no conflicting requirement or task ordering. Open synthetic source/wiki questions are explicitly distinguished from the accepted feature-scoped answers.

**Prerequisites and hooks:** Installed required prerequisite check succeeded for specs/802-normalize-text and returned research.md, data-model.md, contracts/, quickstart.md and tasks.md. Required specification, plan, tasks and constitution exist and were read. extensions.yml parsed successfully; neither before_analyze nor after_analyze has registered hooks. No prerequisite errors.

**Next Actions:** Return this fresh analysis to the existing eligibility assessment. No remediation or additional workflow is requested. This analysis assesses consistency and coverage; it does not independently prove task implementation or feature acceptance.

**Remediation:** No issues require proposed edits.
